en: Added offline build updates to the internal demo information page.
Reopen the same information page from the Lio menu.
Improved greetings and sent-message display at larger text sizes.
Copy a whole greeting or select part of a sent message.
zh: 内部演示说明中新增离线的本版更新。
可以从 Lio 菜单重新打开同一页面。
改善开场白和已发消息的显示，保留大字号和浅深色。
开场白可整段复制，已发消息可选择部分文字复制。

en: Since build 43: offline notes and clearer, selectable chat text.
Trip planning and default chat access remain unchanged.
zh: 与构建 43 相比，新增离线说明，改善对话文字显示和复制。
规划功能没有因此修好，日常账号的默认对话方式没有改变。

en: Open Internal demo information in the Lio menu; read both builds.
Try light and dark appearances, then increase system text size.
Copy a greeting or one sent word; paste without sending.
Keep an unsent draft, leave the app, then check the same chat.
zh: 从 Lio 菜单打开内部演示说明，查看本版和上一版。
切换浅色和深色，并调大系统文字，查看内容是否完整。
复制开场白或已发消息中的一个词，粘贴核对但先不发送。
留一段未发送文字，切后台再返回，检查同一对话和草稿。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning is still being fixed. Please do not test it yet.
Planning, saving, edits, undo and preferences await live checks.
Please hold off on accepting that complete trip journey.
Segmented replies, choices and profile tags are designated tests.
They are not on by default for everyday accounts.
zh: 规划功能仍在修复，暂不建议测试规划。
规划、保存、修改、撤销和记住偏好尚待本轮真实验证。
请暂不进行这组完整流程的验收。
新版分段、多选和画像交互目前仅供指定测试。
这些交互未向日常账号默认开启。

en: The Hong Kong online service is using source 7750871.
Failure diagnostics are live; this server update does not require an app update.
Basic questions have not passed every check; diagnostics do not mean planning is fixed.
zh: 香港在线服务来源为 7750871。
失败诊断已上线，这项在线更新不需要更新应用。
基础问答尚未全部通过，新增诊断不代表规划已经修复。

en: Improved trip detail titles at larger text sizes.
zh: 改善行程详情标题显示，保留完整标题和大字号。

en: Since build 42: title display only; planning remained unfixed.
zh: 与构建 42 相比，仅调整标题显示，未宣告规划修复。

en: Open an existing trip; check its title in light and dark.
Increase system text size; check that the full title is readable.
zh: 打开已有行程，在浅深色下查看标题。
调大系统文字，查看是否仍能读到完整标题。

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

en: Trip planning was still being fixed; planning acceptance was on hold.
zh: 规划功能当时仍在修复，规划验收暂未开放。

en: These notes for build 43 were added later.
Server work was tracked separately and did not prove successful planning.
That app update did not establish that the server was fixed.
zh: 这是构建 43 的补记说明。
在线服务进展单独记录，不代表规划已经通过。
不应把该次应用更新理解为服务端已经修复。
